headline: Computer hardware will get more expensive again. This is not a good time to buy a computer
summary: Consumer electronics buyers face higher prices for high-end computers as shortages of RAM and SSDs continue. Buyers of gaming and creative equipment may need to wait or pay more.
why: Memory chips such as DRAM and NAND flash are key components whose supply and pricing affect PC and laptop makers and their margins.
